title: Material collected for recycling in Alderport, 2020 and 2025
bodyMd: The bar chart shows the tonnage of each material collected for recycling in the city of Alderport in 2020 and in 2025. Only these four materials were collected in either year.

data.caption: Tonnes of paper, glass, metal and plastic collected for recycling in Alderport in 2020 and 2025.

accessibilityText: A grouped bar chart with four materials on the horizontal axis and tonnes collected on the vertical axis, with one bar for 2020 and one for 2025 above each material. Paper: 3,500 tonnes in 2020 and 4,200 tonnes in 2025. Glass: 2,000 tonnes in 2020 and 1,800 tonnes in 2025. Metal: 1,000 tonnes in 2020 and 1,200 tonnes in 2025. Plastic: 2,000 tonnes in 2020 and 2,800 tonnes in 2025. The four materials total 8,500 tonnes in 2020 and 10,000 tonnes in 2025.

provenance.notes: Original data set written for this item bank. The city and all tonnages are invented; the values were chosen so that every percent change asked about is a whole number.
